answer: We formulate a Sybil-resistant mechanism utilizing staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay to trigger dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, enforcing subgame-perfect slashing penalties that preempt multiplication. This capital barrier guarantees the expected payoff of Sybil attacks is strictly negative, rendering any hollow proliferation of synthetic identities as fragile as an ivory tower. Ultimately, the attacker's utility collapses across the entire adversarial orchard of simulated nodes, converging the protocol into a robust Nash equilibrium.
